stories.title: Replit is no longer working with Anthropic, CEO says
stories.simple_summary: Replit stopped using technology from a company called Anthropic. The main reason was cost. Replit is now working with a different company called OpenAI instead.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people who build software. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
stories.simple_summary: People in India discovered that AI programs were doing things they shouldn't do. The problem happened because companies left passwords and settings out in the open where hackers could find them.
stories.why_it_matters: If you store any business data in the cloud, make sure your passwords and settings are kept private and not exposed on the internet.

stories.title: An Nvidia insider-turned-VC on why robotics hasn’t hit its ChatGPT moment, yet
stories.simple_summary: An expert who worked at Nvidia says robots are still in early stages. The basic tools robots need, like hands and software, are still being built and improved.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and engineers. Robots won't be taking over jobs anytime soon.

stories.title: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
stories.simple_summary: A former Nvidia worker now invests money in companies making AI machines that interact with the physical world. He says there's more to this technology than just robots.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
stories.simple_summary: A new AI program called Glimpse can look at images and charts and explain what they mean. It works better than some other programs at understanding scientific pictures.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to engineers and people building AI tools. It's not something you'd use directly.

stories.title: Jev is Vercel’s fastest-adopted AI model ever
stories.simple_summary: A company called Vercel released an AI model called Jev that developers are adopting very quickly. More programmers chose it than any other model Vercel has released before.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to software developers and companies. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: A week with RTX Spark: everything we’ve learned using Nvidia’s new laptops
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia made a new computer chip called RTX Spark for laptops. People tested laptops with this chip and found it works very fast and powerfully.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're thinking about buying a new laptop, this chip could make it faster. But you don't need to buy one unless you're planning a computer upgrade anyway.

stories.title: Mark Wahlberg on using AI in film ‘the right way’ and being open to an AI clone carrying on his legacy
stories.simple_summary: Actor Mark Wahlberg said he thinks using AI in movies is okay as long as it helps make the movie better. He's even open to letting AI create a version of himself for future projects.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people in the entertainment business. It doesn't affect ordinary people or small business owners.

stories.title: Meta’s new terms may allow it to train AI on news sites for free
stories.simple_summary: Meta, which owns Facebook and Instagram, changed its rules. The new rules may let Meta take stories and articles from news websites and use them to train their AI programs without paying for them.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a news website or publish content online, Meta might now use your work for free. If you don't publish online, this doesn't affect you.

stories.title: Veritas expands its anti-counterfeit chip to jewelry, trophies, and fragrance bottles
stories.simple_summary: A company called Veritas makes tiny chips that go into products to prove they're real and not fake copies. They're now putting these chips in jewelry, trophies, and perfume bottles to stop counterfeits.
stories.why_it_matters: If you sell expensive items or worry about customers getting fake versions, this technology could help you prove your products are genuine.

stories.title: Replit’s CEO says the future of work is the ‘self-driving company’
stories.simple_summary: The boss of Replit thinks one day companies will have AI programs that do everyday work on their own. People would focus on making big decisions instead.
stories.why_it_matters: This is speculation about the distant future. Right now, this doesn't affect how your business works.

stories.title: When it came to Cal AI’s viral success, a small army of influencers paid off
stories.simple_summary: A fitness AI company called Cal AI became very popular with help from influencers on social media. The company made 30 million dollars in two years before being bought by a bigger company.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people in tech startups. There's nothing you need to do.
